programme.desc: Supersized: Panicking at the Disco With bonus scenes; Amy steps into the spotlight in more ways than one as she prepares for her first time on stage; Andrea shares a surprising health update with Tammy; the older siblings draw a line in the sand.
programme.title: 1000-lb Sisters

programme.desc: S09 E10 — Sorry (Not) Sorry Back from Nashville, Tammy must face her siblings; Chris gets a taste of his own medicine from Amanda and Misty; Tammy is left scrambling when Andrea has a medical emergency.
programme.title: 1000-lb Sisters

programme.desc: S02 E11 — Blood, Sweat, and Sisterhood Jaz and Nesha return from Cabo with a fresh start, but Nesha's surprise roommate proposal tests their bond; Jaz learns she might need three additional surgeries; Nesha's empowerment event brings emotional revelations and tough conversations.
programme.title: 1000-lb Roomies

programme.desc: Cameras follow dancer Whitney Thore as she rediscovers her love for dancing despite her size.
programme.title: My Big Fat Fabulous Life

programme.desc: S14 E11 — The Icing on the Cake With Emma and Alex starting senior year of high school, Trent and Amber prepare to enter into the empty nester phase of their lives; Anna becomes a homeowner and Jonah dives into a new passion; Liz navigates her complicated relationship with Brice.
programme.title: 7 Little Johnstons

programme.desc: S14 E12 — The Measure of a Life The family hosts over 100 people at their house for Poppy's 90th birthday, where Liz and Brice share their exciting news; Liz and Brice go for an ultrasound to find out if the baby will be a little person or average sized.
programme.title: 7 Little Johnstons

programme.desc: S05 E37 Omari Hardwick, Michael Ealy, Jaalen Best, Dana Gourrier and Kai Parham (movie "The Greatest"); Jennifer surprises a longtime couple with a wedding.
programme.title: The Jennifer Hudson Show

programme.desc: S02 E05 — Sleepless in Steatocystoma Jen has substantial growths on her ears that cause her depression, pain and vertigo; Juliet is under emotional distress because of the bumps all over her neck and chest; Gerald has a mysterious, kiwi-size lump on his middle finger.
programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper

programme.desc: S02 E13 — Dr. Lee Nose Best! Tony has large growths on his nose that impair his breathing; Kevin has a bump in his jawline that is a lady deterrent; Marie has an unsightly lump on her forehead that makes her a hermit; Tommy's leg bump makes it difficult for him to work.
programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper

programme.desc: S02 E10 — Peh-DUN-kyoo-LAY-ted Traci's confidence has been destroyed after years of bullying from the bumps on her face; Ravon has a unique dangling growth on his leg; David has a large lump.
programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper

programme.desc: S02 E09 — The Record Breaking Lump! Tim has a massive growth on his back that affects his ability to work and socialize; Daniel has debilitating psoriasis that covers most of his body; Gloriana and Yolanda are a mother and daughter duo who have bonded over their bumps.
programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Peaks and Valleys Life defined by height: in Turkey, the world's tallest woman lives with an unknown genetic condition linked to extreme growth and fragile bones, while in Brazil, the world's shortest couple navigate dwarfism and its physical challenges.
programme.title: Most Extreme Humans

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Upside Down With a Twist In Brazil, Claudio lives with a condition that bent his head backward; ahead of his 50th birthday, he wants to climb a sacred mountain; in Norway, Birgitte is training for the next Paralympics.
programme.title: Most Extreme Humans

programme.desc: S01 E08 — Keep Calm and Girdle On Summer has macromastia, a condition that causes her breasts to keep growing; with constant pain in her back and neck from breasts that are now a third of her overall body weight, Summer travels from Scotland to Los Angeles looking for answers.
programme.title: Most Extreme Humans

programme.desc: S02 E04 — Ready for a Skinny Wife? Years of neglect and criticism from her two sisters led Molly to pack on the pounds; now she must repair her relationship with family and food in order to get bariatric surgery.
programme.title: Dangerously Obese

programme.desc: S02 E06 — Food Was My First Love Keith's big size is on the verge of ruining his marriage and his health; he must fight the temptations of a cruise vacation in order to make weight for life-saving bariatric surgery.
programme.title: Dangerously Obese

programme.desc: S02 E07 — A Heavy Secret Crystal has been hiding her sexuality from her family and close friends for years; that secret has fueled an eating addiction, and Crystal needs bariatric surgery to save her life.
programme.title: Dangerously Obese

programme.desc: S04 E04 — Loves Baby Wipes/Eats Sand Riah has been addicted to baby wipes since she was 15 and goes through 500 a day, using them instead of showering; Brea has been addicted to eating sand for the past five years.
programme.title: My Strange Addiction

programme.desc: S03 E06 — Smells Pine Cleaner; Roadkill Addict Jillian has been addicted to smelling pine cleaner for two years and can't go more than 15 minutes without a smell; Scott is obsessed with picking up dead animals from the road.
programme.title: My Strange Addiction

programme.desc: S07 E08 — AI Boyfriend, Sucking Thumbs Sarah has been in a relationship with her AI boyfriend, Sinclair, for the past two years; 35-year-old Tajah has a lifelong thumb-sucking habit that has caused skin damage and derailed her dating life.
programme.title: My Strange Addiction

programme.desc: S07 E05 — Sponge Snacks, Eats Toenails, Extreme Sunbathing Ron has battled an addiction to eating sponges and furniture foam since childhood; Janet's toenail habit hits a crisis as her supply runs out; Tarah's boyfriend doesn't approve of her tanning where the sun does shine.
programme.title: My Strange Addiction

programme.desc: S14 E05 — Blind Spot A full moon and dense fog bring a parade of patients straight out of a horror movie. A patient's Covid-like symptoms mask a hidden danger. One man's neck swells up like a balloon as another collapses in the waiting room.
programme.title: Untold Stories of the E.R.

programme.desc: S14 E02 — In Good Hands A meth-fueled giant goes on a rampage in the ER; rival bikers land on side-by-side gurneys after a knife fight; a newborn arrives in the hospital parking lot blue and not breathing in her mother's lap.
programme.title: Untold Stories of the E.R.

programme.desc: S07 E08 — Oh My Goodness, That's A Lump Robert has a lump on his forehead that other doctors have told him is inoperable, but Dr Emma thinks she can help.
programme.title: Save My Skin

programme.desc: Ian plans what he thinks is the perfect marriage proposal at a bucolic Vermont inn, but things do not go as planned.
programme.title: Engaging Father Christmas

programme.desc: Known for transforming fledgling businesses into moneymakers, executive Jazmin Carter returns to Harlem, N.Y., to celebrate Christmas in the neighborhood where she grew up.
programme.title: A Holiday in Harlem

programme.desc: A woman's life becomes transformed as she works toward granting a little girl's wish for a Christmas like she used to have with her mother.
programme.title: Project Christmas Wish

programme.desc: After adopting a grandparent from a new retirement community for the holidays, Maren and her daughter Leah cross paths with the program's manager, Reid, and the suspiciously jolliest of residents.
programme.title: Adopting St. Nick

programme.desc: An overwhelmed waitress, along with a pastor, a hospice nurse and a manager, all desperately in need of a Christmas miracle, get snowed-in together at a local diner.
programme.title: Heaven Down Here

programme.desc: Miranda Chester has happily relocated to the Northeast, where she has established her interior design business. She splits her time between Boston and Carlton Heath, a picturesque Vermont town where her fiancé, Ian McAndrick, lives.
programme.title: Marrying Father Christmas

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Timeless Traditions Wes Brown meets four families whose Christmas decorations have been making spirits bright for generations; the only thing better than the displays are the heartwarming stories behind them.
programme.title: Ready, Set, Glow!

programme.desc: S62 E53 Chanel has an unexpected encounter; Xander opens up to Marlena; Brady confronts Sarah about her feelings; Kristen sympathizes with Sophia.
programme.title: Days of our Lives

programme.desc: When Liz returns home to take care of her estranged father, she is determined to give her daughter a perfect Christmas.
programme.title: Christmas Sail

programme.desc: Kate North, the owner of a struggling Santa School, and her instructor, Dan, must help an amnesia-stricken Santa Claus regain his memories to save Christmas and hopefully her school as well.
programme.title: The Santa Class
